title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion, Stanford on 1973-02-09
source: Recording Info: MR > R (Bob Menke) > R (Pat Lee); Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Mastered By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture is a bit patchy and uneven, but the show delivers smoky jams and standout performances like Eyes, Playing in the Band and a fiery Sugaree.
ai_review.review: The recording is an SBD that suffers from balance issues and occasional muddiness, making it sound “patchy” at times. Musically, the concert shines with long, exploratory jams (18‑minute "Eyes", a full‑blown Playing in the Band) and several dance‑floor favorites such as "Deal", "Sugaree" and "Loose Lucy". Overall the performance is mellow yet adventurous, offset by the imperfect tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star scores; the musical content is praised with many standout jams, while the recording is described as patchy and unbalanced, leading to a solid but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Patchy, messy tape; balance never quite right throughout; some sections sound fat and clear, others are muddy or unbalanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set feels like a rehearsal with many new tunes, second set builds into long improvisations and a strong jam marathon.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia shreds with prolific licks; his voice is described as pristine on Sugaree.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is highlighted for its “fat sound” and thunderous presence; he even sings on Mexicali.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s lyric changes on B.T.W. didn’t flow naturally, but his rhythm work is noted throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (the keyboards) finally appears in the mix, adding depth to the overall sound.
